title: Working Holiday
subtitle: 「工作假期／邊工作邊旅行的海外逗留」，究竟是哪一種 working holiday？
description: 「工作假期／邊工作邊旅行的海外逗留」，究竟是哪一種 working holiday？

words.meaning: 工作旅遊停留；邊工作邊旅行的逗留
words.note: 最直接的描述性替換之一，表示在外地停留期間一邊旅行、一邊從事短期工作；比 working holiday 更透明地表達兩個目的。
words.example: She spent six months on a work-and-travel stay in New Zealand.
words.exampleZh: 她在紐西蘭度過了六個月的工作旅遊停留。

exercises.original: She took a working holiday in Australia after finishing university.
exercises.zh: 她大學畢業後到澳洲進行工作假期。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel stay · 工作旅遊停留；邊工作邊旅行的逗留

options.explanation: business trip = 原句不是為公司出差，而是旅行兼短期工作。
gap year = 可能發生在 gap year，但原句更具體是邊工作邊旅行。
work-and-travel stay = 在海外停留一段時間並一邊工作、一邊旅行時，work-and-travel stay 很直接。
vacation = 單純 vacation 不包括就業。
internship abroad = 沒有職業訓練或實習線索。
seasonal work = 只涵蓋工作部分，沒有整段旅行逗留。

exercises.original: He spent nine months on a working holiday across Canada.
exercises.zh: 他在加拿大度過九個月的工作假期。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel stay · 工作旅遊停留；邊工作邊旅行的逗留

options.explanation: work visa = 簽證本身不會 spend nine months on。
business trip = 九個月且跨地旅行，不像公幹。
holiday job = 只是一份工作，不是整段逗留。
work-and-travel stay = spent nine months 強調整段海外工作旅行停留，最適合 work-and-travel stay。
vacation = 忽略工作部分。
internship = 未有實習目的。

exercises.original: Their working holiday included farm work, city travel, and short-term jobs.
exercises.zh: 他們的工作假期包括農場工作、城市旅行和短期工作。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel stay · 工作旅遊停留；邊工作邊旅行的逗留

options.explanation: seasonal work = 只涵蓋 farm work，不涵蓋整段 travel。
business travel = 不是僱主派遣。
vacation = 沒有就業含義。
internship abroad = 工作內容不一定具訓練性。
work-and-travel stay = 同時包含 travel 和 short-term jobs，這個描述最貼切。
work permit = 只是法律文件。

words.note: 較完整、解釋性的說法，強調旅行／度假期間包含臨時工作；適合向不熟悉 working holiday 制度的人解釋。
words.example: He planned a holiday with temporary employment so he could support himself while travelling.
words.exampleZh: 他計劃一段兼有短期工作的假期，讓自己可以一邊旅行一邊負擔生活費。

exercises.original: A working holiday lets travellers earn money while they explore the country.
exercises.zh: 工作假期讓旅客在探索當地時賺取收入。
exercises.upgrade: holiday with temporary employment · 兼有短期工作的假期

options.explanation: vacation = 未包括 earn money through work。
business trip = 工作是主目的，與 explore country 的休閒性不同。
seasonal job = 只是一份工作。
holiday with temporary employment = 若向不熟悉術語的人解釋 working holiday，holiday with temporary employment 很清楚。
internship = 未必是短期旅遊型就業。
gap year = 太廣。

exercises.original: She wanted a working holiday rather than a purely tourist trip.
exercises.zh: 她想要一段有短期工作的假期，而不是純觀光旅行。
exercises.upgrade: holiday with temporary employment · 兼有短期工作的假期

options.explanation: business trip = 不是因公工作。
ordinary vacation = 正是句子排除的選項。
full-time job abroad = 工作比重過重。
internship abroad = 未有訓練目的。
holiday with temporary employment = rather than a purely tourist trip 清楚突出假期中加入臨時工作。
study abroad = 不合。

exercises.original: The working holiday allowed him to cover some travel costs through short-term jobs.
exercises.zh: 工作假期讓他透過短期工作支付部分旅費。
exercises.upgrade: holiday with temporary employment · 兼有短期工作的假期

options.explanation: vacation only = 沒有 employment。
work placement = 不一定含旅行。
business travel = 費用通常由工作方承擔。
seasonal employment = 沒有 holiday/travel 部分。
gap year = 範圍太廣。
holiday with temporary employment = 短期工作用來補貼旅費，正好符合這個解釋性說法。

words.note: 和 working holiday 非常接近，強調整段在海外以工作假期形式停留的期間，而不是簽證本身。
words.example: Her working-holiday stay lasted almost a year.
words.exampleZh: 她的工作假期逗留接近一年。

exercises.original: Her working holiday lasted eleven months.
exercises.zh: 她的工作假期逗留持續了十一個月。
exercises.upgrade: working-holiday stay · 工作假期逗留

options.explanation: working-holiday visa = 簽證可以有效十一個月，但原句是在談她的經歷／逗留。
seasonal job = 不一定持續整段時間。
business trip = 不合。
vacation = 忽略就業。
working-holiday stay = 談整段在海外以工作假期形式停留的期間，working-holiday stay 最自然。
internship = 不合。

exercises.original: During his working holiday, he lived in three different cities.
exercises.zh: 在工作假期期間，他住過三個不同城市。
exercises.upgrade: working-holiday stay · 工作假期逗留

options.explanation: work visa = 不能說 during his visa 來指生活經歷。
holiday job = 只是一份工作。
business trip = 不符合多地生活旅行。
study period = 未有學習線索。
vacation only = 忽略工作安排。
working-holiday stay = lived in three different cities 表示一整段 overseas stay，而不是單一工作。

exercises.original: She extended her working holiday by several months.
exercises.zh: 她把工作假期逗留延長了數個月。
exercises.upgrade: working-holiday stay · 工作假期逗留

options.explanation: working-holiday stay = 若延長的是整段工作旅行停留，working-holiday stay 很準確。
business trip = 不合。
holiday job = 不能自然表示整體海外逗留。
internship = 未有實習語境。
seasonal work = 只涵蓋工作部分。
vacation = 不完整。

words.note: 當 working holiday 指由政府、學校、機構或旅行服務安排的計劃時很自然；比 stay 更偏制度或項目。
words.example: The agency helps young adults join work-and-travel programmes overseas.
words.exampleZh: 這間機構協助年輕人參加海外工作旅遊計劃。

exercises.original: The agency offers a working holiday for young adults in several countries.
exercises.zh: 這間機構為年輕人提供多個國家的工作旅遊計劃。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel programme · 工作旅遊計劃

options.explanation: business trip = agency 不是安排公司公幹。
vacation package = 未包括合法工作。
internship programme = 未必是實習。
seasonal job = 不是完整 programme。
work visa = agency 可協助申請，但不是整個 programme。
work-and-travel programme = 由 agency 提供、有多國選項的安排最自然是 work-and-travel programme。

exercises.original: Students can apply for a working holiday through the university partner.
exercises.zh: 學生可透過大學合作機構申請工作旅遊計劃。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel programme · 工作旅遊計劃

options.explanation: work-and-travel programme = apply through the university partner 顯示這是正式 programme。
business travel scheme = 目的不同。
vacation = 通常不說 apply for vacation through a university partner。
holiday job = 只是一份工作。
gap year = 不是特定申請項目。
internship = 未有專業訓練線索。

exercises.original: The working holiday includes orientation, job support, and travel advice.
exercises.zh: 工作旅遊計劃包括迎新、求職支援和旅遊建議。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel programme · 工作旅遊計劃

options.explanation: vacation = 不會通常包含 job support。
work-and-travel programme = 有 orientation、job support 和 travel advice 的整套服務就是 programme。
work visa = 簽證本身不包含 orientation。
seasonal job = 不涵蓋 travel advice。
business trip = 不合。
internship placement = 未必包括廣泛 travel。

words.note: 較正式，指讓合資格旅客在旅行期間合法從事短期工作的制度或項目；常見於政府、教育和旅遊語境。
words.example: The working holiday programme allows eligible visitors to take short-term jobs.
words.exampleZh: 工作假期計劃容許合資格旅客從事短期工作。

exercises.original: The country introduced a working holiday for eligible young travellers.
exercises.zh: 該國為合資格的年輕旅客推出工作假期計劃。
exercises.upgrade: working holiday programme · 工作假期計劃

options.explanation: working holiday programme = 政府推出、對特定年齡旅客開放的制度最自然叫 working holiday programme。
vacation = 政府不會以 eligible young travellers 為條件推出一般度假。
business trip = 不合。
seasonal work scheme = 可能只是其中一部分。
internship scheme = 目的不同。
ordinary work visa = 範圍和資格條件不同。

exercises.original: The working holiday allows participants to travel and take temporary jobs.
exercises.zh: 工作假期計劃容許參加者旅行並從事短期工作。
exercises.upgrade: working holiday programme · 工作假期計劃

options.explanation: vacation programme = 沒有 employment。
working holiday programme = 制度同時允許 travel + temporary jobs，這就是 working holiday programme。
business travel scheme = 不是旅遊體驗型制度。
internship programme = 工作類型更受限制。
seasonal-work programme = 沒有 general travel component。
work permit = 只是許可文件。

exercises.original: Applicants must meet the age rules of the working holiday.
exercises.zh: 申請人必須符合工作假期計劃的年齡規定。
exercises.upgrade: working holiday programme · 工作假期計劃

options.explanation: holiday job = 通常沒有國家層級 age rules。
business trip = 不需這類 programme eligibility。
working holiday programme = applicants + age rules 表明是正式 programme，而非普通旅行。
vacation = 不合。
gap year = 沒有統一申請年齡規則。
seasonal job = 條件性質不同。

words.note: 當重點是個人的海外生活、工作和旅行體驗，而不是簽證或政策本身時可用。
words.example: Her work-travel experience helped her become more independent.
words.exampleZh: 她的工作旅遊經歷令她變得更獨立。

exercises.original: Her working holiday taught her how to live independently abroad.
exercises.zh: 她的工作旅遊經歷教會她如何在海外獨立生活。
exercises.upgrade: work-travel experience · 工作旅遊經歷

options.explanation: work visa = 法律文件不會『教會』她獨立生活。
work-travel experience = 如果重點是個人成長和海外體驗，work-travel experience 很自然。
business trip = 通常不以個人成長為主要體驗。
holiday job = 只是一份工作。
vacation = 缺少 employment。
internship = 未有專業訓練線索。

exercises.original: He described his working holiday as the most memorable year of his twenties.
exercises.zh: 他形容那段工作旅遊經歷是二十多歲時最難忘的一年。
exercises.upgrade: work-travel experience · 工作旅遊經歷

options.explanation: business travel = 不合 memorable year 的生活體驗感。
work permit = 不是經歷。
work-travel experience = 談回憶、成長、生活體驗時，用 experience 最貼切。
vacation = 忽略工作。
seasonal job = 太窄。
internship abroad = 未有職訓語境。

exercises.original: The working holiday gave her confidence and international experience.
exercises.zh: 工作旅遊經歷令她更有自信，也累積了國際經驗。
exercises.upgrade: work-travel experience · 工作旅遊經歷

options.explanation: holiday job = 未涵蓋 travel/life experience。
business trip = 通常太短且目的不同。
vacation = 缺少工作。
work-travel experience = 強調個人獲得 confidence 和 experience，work-travel experience 很自然。
work visa = 不是體驗本身。
internship = 可能帶來經驗，但語境未限定專業訓練。

words.note: 當 working holiday 的重點是短期在海外居住並工作時可用；比原詞更偏工作與居留，較少突出度假。
words.example: He used the year for a temporary overseas work stay before university.
words.exampleZh: 他在入讀大學前利用那一年作海外短期工作逗留。

exercises.original: He spent part of his working holiday employed at a ski resort.
exercises.zh: 他在工作假期的一部分時間於滑雪度假村工作。
exercises.upgrade: temporary overseas work stay · 海外短期工作逗留

options.explanation: business trip = 不是公司派遣。
vacation = 有受僱工作，不只是休假。
temporary overseas work stay = 如果句子重點放在海外短期受僱和居留，這個說法可用。
holiday job at home = 原句是海外逗留。
internship = 未有訓練內容。
work visa = 不是 stay 本身。

exercises.original: Her working holiday involved several short-term jobs abroad.
exercises.zh: 她的工作假期包括數份海外短期工作。
exercises.upgrade: temporary overseas work stay · 海外短期工作逗留

options.explanation: vacation = 沒有 job component。
business trip = 不是短期僱傭輪換式旅行。
gap year = 太廣。
temporary overseas work stay = 多份海外短工 + 一段逗留，temporary overseas work stay 很合適。
internship abroad = 工作未必有訓練目的。
seasonal job = 只是一份工作。

exercises.original: He chose a working holiday before beginning his full-time career.
exercises.zh: 他在開始全職事業前選擇了一段海外短期工作逗留。
exercises.upgrade: temporary overseas work stay · 海外短期工作逗留

options.explanation: business trip = 不是事業前的個人選擇型旅行。
vacation = 忽略工作。
internship = 沒有職訓線索。
work visa = 不是整段經歷。
temporary overseas work stay = 若凸顯暫時海外工作、之後回國開始正職，這個替換很精確。
seasonal work only = 太窄。

words.note: 較正式、概括，表示一種讓人同時旅行和從事短期工作的安排；適合政策、規劃或一般解釋。
words.example: The travel-and-work arrangement gave participants flexibility to move between cities.
words.exampleZh: 這項旅行兼工作安排讓參加者可以靈活地在不同城市之間移動。

exercises.original: The working holiday gave participants freedom to move between regions and take short jobs.
exercises.zh: 工作假期讓參加者可在不同地區之間移動並從事短期工作。
exercises.upgrade: travel-and-work arrangement · 旅行兼工作安排

options.explanation: business travel policy = 不是僱主出差安排。
vacation package = 不包含 take short jobs。
internship agreement = 太偏職訓。
travel-and-work arrangement = 如果重點是 travel + work 的制度性安排，travel-and-work arrangement 很清楚。
work permit = 只是授權文件。
seasonal job = 沒有移動和旅行部分。

exercises.original: The working holiday was flexible enough to combine part-time work with travel.
exercises.zh: 這項工作假期安排很靈活，可以把兼職和旅行結合。
exercises.upgrade: travel-and-work arrangement · 旅行兼工作安排

options.explanation: vacation = 沒有 part-time work。
business trip = 不是 personal flexible arrangement。
internship = 未必可自由旅行。
holiday job = 只涵蓋工作。
travel-and-work arrangement = combine part-time work with travel 直接支持 travel-and-work arrangement。
work visa = 不等於整體安排。

exercises.original: They chose a working holiday because it offered more flexibility than a fixed internship.
exercises.zh: 他們選擇工作假期，因為這種旅行兼工作安排比固定實習更靈活。
exercises.upgrade: travel-and-work arrangement · 旅行兼工作安排

options.explanation: internship abroad = 句子正是在與它對比。
business trip = 不合。
vacation = 缺少工作。
seasonal job = 太窄。
employment contract = 沒有 travel component。
travel-and-work arrangement = 與 fixed internship 對比、強調自由度時，這個概括最精確。

words.note: 當 working holiday 被當作一次具體海外旅行來談時可用；重點在整段旅程，而不是制度。
words.example: They saved for months before starting their working holiday trip.
words.exampleZh: 他們儲蓄了數月才開始工作假期旅程。

exercises.original: They planned their working holiday for months before flying overseas.
exercises.zh: 他們在出發海外前花了數月規劃工作假期旅程。
exercises.upgrade: working holiday trip · 工作假期旅程

options.explanation: business trip = 不是工作任務出差。
vacation = 沒有臨時受僱部分。
work visa = 可申請，但不是整段 trip。
holiday job = 只是一份工作。
working holiday trip = 當 working holiday 被當作一趟具體旅行來規劃時，working holiday trip 很自然。
internship = 未有實習語境。

exercises.original: Her working holiday began with a month of travel before she found a job.
exercises.zh: 她的工作假期旅程先以一個月旅行開始，之後才找到工作。
exercises.upgrade: working holiday trip · 工作假期旅程

options.explanation: work visa = 簽證不會 began with a month of travel。
business trip = 不合。
seasonal job = 工作甚至尚未開始。
vacation = 只涵蓋第一個月。
internship = 不合。
working holiday trip = 有清楚 itinerary sequence 的整段旅程可稱 working holiday trip。

exercises.original: They documented their working holiday in a travel blog.
exercises.zh: 他們在旅遊網誌記錄工作假期旅程。
exercises.upgrade: working holiday trip · 工作假期旅程

options.explanation: working holiday trip = travel blog 表明句子把 working holiday 當作一趟旅程來談。
work permit = 不會在 travel blog 記錄文件本身。
business travel = 不合。
holiday job = 太窄。
vacation = 忽略工作部分。
internship = 不合。

words.note: 當重點是某人在海外一邊工作一邊旅行的那段時間時很自然；比 programme 更偏時間階段。
words.example: During her work-and-travel period, she worked in cafés and travelled on weekends.
words.exampleZh: 在工作旅遊期間，她在咖啡店工作，並於週末旅行。

exercises.original: During her working holiday, she worked weekdays and explored nearby towns at weekends.
exercises.zh: 在工作旅遊期間，她平日工作，週末探索附近城鎮。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel period · 工作旅遊期間

options.explanation: business trip = 不合生活型長期安排。
vacation = 平日有工作。
seasonal job = 未涵蓋週末旅行。
internship = 未必。
work visa = 不能表示整段生活時期。
work-and-travel period = 若重點是那段生活階段如何安排，work-and-travel period 很自然。

exercises.original: She saved money before her working holiday so she could travel between jobs.
exercises.zh: 她在工作旅遊期間前先存錢，以便在不同工作之間旅行。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel period · 工作旅遊期間

options.explanation: work-and-travel period = 描述一段由多份短工與旅行構成的時期，work-and-travel period 很精確。
vacation = 沒有 between jobs 的安排。
business trip = 不合。
internship = 通常不是多份 jobs 之間移動。
holiday job = 只是其中一份工作。
work permit = 不是時間階段。

exercises.original: The working holiday gave him a year away from his usual routine.
exercises.zh: 工作旅遊期間讓他有一年時間離開平常生活。
exercises.upgrade: work-and-travel period · 工作旅遊期間

options.explanation: business trip = 通常短且工作主導。
work-and-travel period = a year away from his usual routine 強調人生中的一段時期，最適合 period。
vacation = 一年中有工作，不只是度假。
seasonal job = 不涵蓋全年。
internship = 未有固定實習內容。
work visa = 是文件而非生活階段。

falseSynonyms.zh: 公幹不等於 working holiday business trip 主要是為僱主或工作任務出差；working holiday 則以旅行和生活體驗為主，工作通常是臨時性的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A business trip is work-led; a working holiday combines travel with temporary employment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 工作簽證不等於 working holiday work visa 是廣義工作許可；working holiday 通常是特定計劃／簽證類別，並附有年齡、國籍和停留限制。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A working holiday may require a special visa, but not every work visa is a working-holiday visa.

falseSynonyms.zh: 假期工不等於 working holiday holiday job 是在假期期間做的工作，通常可在本地完成；working holiday 通常涉及海外旅行和逗留。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A holiday job can be local; a working holiday normally involves travel abroad.

falseSynonyms.zh: 間隔年不一定是 working holiday gap year 是學業或工作之間的一段空檔，可以旅行、義工、讀書或工作；不一定邊旅行邊受僱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A working holiday can be part of a gap year, but a gap year is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 海外實習不等於 working holiday internship abroad 主要是職業訓練或實習；working holiday 通常更自由、更偏短期工作加旅行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An overseas internship is training-focused; a working holiday is travel-and-work focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 度假本身不包括工作 vacation 主要是休息或旅行，不表示會合法從事臨時工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A vacation is for leisure; a working holiday also includes employment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 季節性工作不等於 working holiday seasonal work 指某季節的短期工作，可能在本地或海外；它可以是 working holiday 的一部分，但不是整個概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Seasonal work may fund a working holiday, but it is only the employment part.

falseSynonyms.zh: 旅程與簽證不是同一概念 working holiday 可指整段經歷；working-holiday visa 則是讓這種活動合法進行的簽證類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The visa authorizes the stay; the working holiday is the broader experience.
